title: Fixed Axial Crown Wheel and Weighted Crossbar Display
description: One wholly newly authored static crown-wheel and weighted-crossbar teaching display. A grounded full bed and two-post upper bridge carry a vertical spindle with two complete splayed pallet plates and a complete horizontal top bar with two fixed end weights. An independent rear grounded standard carries a perpendicular horizontal shaft, open-spoke hub and one integral thick crown ring whose blunt teeth project axially from its rim rather than radially from a flat disk. Opposite-height pallet plates sit visibly clear of the wheel tips in this illustrative pose. Unlike the old parallel-shaft forked anchor with long pendulum and flat tooth disk, this whole organization has orthogonal axes, axial crown teeth and top horizontal weighted bar; unlike the governor it has no ball weights, diamond links or sliding sleeve. All coordinates and meshes new, three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, one model zero scenes. No escapement action, precise crown/pallet profile, engaged contact, oscillation, timekeeping, rate, winding, motion, gearing, torque, manufacture, operation or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction are not made.
